entities.summary: Turntablism is the art of manipulating sounds and creating new music, sound effects, mixes and other creative sounds and beats, typically by using two or more turntables and a cross fader-equipped DJ mixer. The mixer is plugged into a PA system or broadcasting equipment so that a wider audience can hear the turntablist's music.
